segments.iti12:2.1: “Kodhaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.iti12:2.2: Kodhañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
segments.iti12:3.5: Pahāya na punāyanti, imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan”ti.
segments.iti12:4.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.

lines: 11-13. Dutiyavaggepi paṭhamādīni tīṇi suttāni vuttanayāneva, tathā desanākāraṇampi vuttameva.
